channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Sponsored: CTML offers lock repairs, key cutting, master key systems and safes
item.description: Advertisement feature: CTML Ltd is a Manchester locksmith offering lock repairs and rebuilds, key cutting, master key systems, alarms and safe work.

item.title: Sponsored: Raf's Cleaning Service offers carpet and upholstery cleaning across Rochdale and Middleton
item.description: Advertisement feature: Raf's Cleaning Service is an Oldham-based family carpet cleaning business, established in 2014, whose area includes Rochdale and Middleton.

item.title: Sponsored: The Physiotherapy Clinic offers physiotherapy, Pilates and home visits in Rochdale
item.description: Advertisement feature: The Physiotherapy Clinic in Rochdale offers physiotherapy for joint, muscle and sports problems, small Pilates classes and home visits.

item.title: Sponsored: DSM Social Media Co. manages social media for businesses from Baillie Street, Rochdale
item.description: Advertisement feature: DSM Social Media Co. is a Rochdale agency offering social media management, content, advertising, training and website design.

item.title: Sponsored: Maqbool and Jones Gardens offers lawn care, hedge trimming and garden clearance in Rochdale
item.description: Advertisement feature: Maqbool and Jones Gardens is a Rochdale gardening business offering regular maintenance, one-off tidy-ups and clearances, with free quotes.

item.title: Sponsored: Rochdale Martial Arts Academy teaches judo and Brazilian jiu jitsu to children and adults
item.description: Advertisement feature: Rochdale Martial Arts Academy runs judo and Brazilian jiu jitsu classes for children and adults, from complete beginners to competitors.

item.title: Sponsored: Precision Multitrade Services offers property maintenance with a 24-hour call-out
item.description: Advertisement feature: Precision Multitrade Services is a family-run property maintenance business covering plumbing, bathrooms, kitchens, flooring and tiling across the North West.

item.title: Sponsored: Hi Pilates Club offers women-only reformer Pilates in Littleborough
item.description: Advertisement feature: Hi Pilates Club is a sister-run, women-only reformer Pilates studio in Littleborough with classes of no more than seven people.

item.title: New Years Eve with the Jäger Maestro
item.description: The irrepressible Jager Maestros return to Littleborough CC to get you swaying, singing, dancing and drinking the New Year in. 🍻🥨🇩🇪 Doors open at 8pm and the show starts at 9pm. Littleborough Cricket Club, Littleborough OL15 9LD, UK

item.title: Sponsored: SJF Granite & Quartz supplies kitchen worktops from its Littleborough showroom
item.description: Advertisement feature: SJF Granite & Quartz is a family-owned supplier of granite and quartz surfaces with a showroom on Church Street, Littleborough.

item.title: Sponsored: Footlights Rochdale runs acting, singing and dance classes for ages 3 to 18
item.description: Advertisement feature: Footlights Rochdale teaches acting, singing and dance to children aged three to 18 at Wardle Academy, with further classes in Milnrow and Sudden.

item.title: Ofsted Releases Inspection Reports for Greenbank Primary and Meadows Schools in Rochdale
item.description: Ofsted has published new inspection reports for Greenbank Primary School and Meadows School, both located in Rochdale, detailing their findings and ratings.

item.title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
item.description: The narrow gorge known as the Thrutch has a real rock niche called the Fairies’ Chapel and a long written tradition of fairy and witch stories — but the fairies themselves belong to folklore, not the official record.

item.title: Family Halloween party coming to Lobden Golf Club on October 31
item.description: Lobden Golf Club will host a family Halloween party on Saturday 31 October, with fancy dress, games, treats and spooky entertainment.

item.title: REEL Cinema Rochdale brings back Polar Express Pyjama Party
item.description: REEL Cinema Rochdale is bringing back its Polar Express Pyjama Party, with tickets including the film, hot chocolate and a Maltesers Reindeer.

item.title: Mayor Faisal Rana visits Rochdale Sixth Form College to see student support and results
item.description: Mayor Faisal Rana and the Mayoress visited Rochdale Sixth Form College, highlighting its student support, pastoral provision and recent academic achievements.

item.title: Construction begins on new banking hub at Morrisons in Heywood
item.description: Construction is under way on a new banking hub at the Morrisons site in Heywood, with Elsie Blundell MP saying the facility is expected to open by the end of October.

item.title: Andy’s Man Club Rochdale has four groups helping men talk
item.description: Andy’s Man Club has four groups meeting across the Rochdale borough, offering men a place to talk, listen and support one another.

item.title: RBH football team takes part in Housing Association Charity Cup 2026
item.description: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing colleagues took part in the Housing Association Charity Cup 2026 after weeks of training, with the team already looking ahead to next year's tournament.

item.title: Ignite Fire Festival returns to Rochdale Town Hall Square from November 20 to 22
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council says the line-up is coming soon for next month's Ignite Fire Festival, promising its most ambitious fire and light installation yet.

item.title: Rochdale Golf Club pair crowned Central England Mixed Foursomes champions
item.description: Rochdale Golf Club's Susan Halpin and Steve Lord have won the Central England Mixed Foursomes Competition at Woodhall Spa after six rounds.

item.title: Heywood Army Cadet Detachment opens its doors for National Cadets Week
item.description: Heywood Army Cadet Detachment is inviting young people and their parents or carers to an open evening on Thursday 8 October to discover what the Army Cadets has to offer.

item.title: Free kids Halloween party coming to Empire Rochdale on October 27
item.description: Empire Rochdale is inviting families to a free Halloween party on Tuesday 27 October, with games, face painting, spooky music and a fancy dress competition.

item.title: Rochdale Foodbank receives more than 430kg of Harvest donations from local churches and school
item.description: Rochdale Foodbank has received more than 430kg of food donations from six local churches and a school as part of this year's Harvest Appeal.

item.title: Christ Church Healey to hold Harvest celebration and special bell-blessing service
item.description: Christ Church Healey will hold its Harvest service on 18 October, followed by a special afternoon service to bless the church bells with the Rt Rev'd Bishop Mark.

item.title: Festival of Remembrance to bring borough together at Rochdale Town Hall on October 16
item.description: Rochdale will come together at Rochdale Town Hall on Friday 16 October for a Festival of Remembrance honouring members of the Armed Forces community.

item.title: Pionero Lounge brings Halloween flavours to Rochdale Riverside
item.description: Pionero Lounge at Rochdale Riverside is getting into the Halloween spirit with seasonal drinks including a new ube iced latte, passionfruit and strawberry bubble tea and sour cherryade.

item.title: Syke Community Base seeks activity providers for its Over 50s group in 2027
item.description: Syke Community Base is looking for activity providers, entertainers, tutors and speakers to run sessions for its Over 50s group throughout 2027.

item.title: Rochdale Procurement 360 Summit highlights opportunities for local businesses
item.description: Businesses and organisations gathered at the Crown Oil Arena for the Rochdale Procurement 360 Summit, with discussions focused on accessing contracts, bidding and local economic growth.

item.title: Syke granted Conservation Area status to protect its historic character
item.description: Syke has been granted Conservation Area status by Rochdale Borough Council, following a consultation in which 33 of 38 responses supported the designation.

item.title: Heywood Civic launches its 10th pantomime with Aladdin
item.description: Heywood Civic has officially launched its 10th pantomime, Aladdin, with Coronation Street favourites Helen Flanagan and Steven Arnold among the cast.

item.title: Constantine Road to Close for Roadworks from 9 October 2026
item.description: Constantine Road in Rochdale will be closed overnight for roadworks from 10pm on 9 October 2026 until 5am on 10 October 2026, affecting all vehicle access except for emergency and delivery vehicles.

item.title: Rochdale Launches Album Celebrating Town's Music History
item.description: A new album showcasing Rochdale's rich musical heritage has been launched, highlighting the town's contributions to the music scene over the years.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of murder after man found deceased on Curzon Road
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has arrested a man on suspicion of murder after a man was found deceased at an address on Curzon Road, Rochdale.

item.title: Mylos Steak & Grill set to arrive at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale
item.description: Mylos Steak & Grill is set to open at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale, although further details about the new restaurant have yet to be announced.

item.title: Rochdale's 'Kenion Street' Album Celebrates Local Music Heritage
item.description: The 'Kenion Street' album, featuring local artists' renditions of iconic tracks, has gained national radio attention, highlighting Rochdale's rich musical history.

item.title: Denehurst Café launches weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk for families and loved ones
item.description: Get Together After Serving CIC is inviting families and loved ones of fallen heroes to join a weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk at Denehurst Park.

item.title: Sara Rowbotham: the Rochdale health worker who raised 181 safeguarding alerts
item.description: Sara Rowbotham repeatedly raised concerns about vulnerable young people while working for Rochdale’s Crisis Intervention Team, later giving evidence to Parliament about the response to child sexual exploitation in the town.

item.title: Restore Britain branch announces Burnley and Hyndburn event with Charlie Downes and Montgomery Toms
item.description: The Restore Britain Burnley & Hyndburn Branch has announced an evening event featuring guest speakers Charlie Downes and Montgomery Toms on Friday 16 October.

item.title: East Lancashire Railway to host first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day
item.description: East Lancashire Railway is inviting prospective volunteers to its first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day at Bury Bolton Street Station on Monday 12 October.

item.title: Sculpt & Edit launches wellness clinic after founder builds business from scratch
item.description: Sculpt & Edit founder Amy has opened a new wellness clinic after finding herself without a job and turning that moment into an opportunity to build her own treatment business, with a focus on lymphatic drainage, post-surgery support and body treatments.

item.title: Nine Suspects Charged with 49 Offences Following Police Operation in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police have charged nine suspects with a total of 49 offences as a result of a recent operation in Rochdale aimed at tackling crime.

item.title: Birtle View Nursery opens at former Birtle site on Bury & Rochdale Old Road
item.description: Birtle View Nursery has opened at 239 Bury & Rochdale Old Road, with Mayor of Rochdale Councillor Faisal Rana attending the opening.

item.title: Rochdale to Face Grimsby Town on 20th October 2026
item.description: Rochdale will host Grimsby Town in a League Two match on 20th October 2026, with both teams looking to improve their standings.

item.title: Rochdale’s Breaking Barriers secures core funding to expand its cultural work across Greater Manchester
item.description: Rochdale-based production company Breaking Barriers has secured three years of GMCA core funding to expand cultural programmes, paid opportunities and creative development across Greater Manchester.

item.title: New Awaab’s Law protections could cover millions more renters and vulnerable households
item.description: A government consultation will examine extending Awaab’s Law to private renters and other accommodation, with faster legal deadlines for landlords to tackle serious hazards such as damp and mould.

item.title: Man Arrested Following Incident in Rochdale
item.description: A man has been arrested as part of an ongoing investigation into an incident in Rochdale, according to Greater Manchester Police.

item.title: Why Rochdale says ‘cruckle’
item.description: Cruckle — the local verb for rolling or twisting an ankle — is a small word with deep dialect roots and a big place in Rochdale identity.

item.title: Rochdale Engineer Develops AI Prototype for Captioning Phone Conversations
item.description: A deaf engineer from Rochdale has created an AI prototype that provides real-time captions for phone conversations, enhancing accessibility for individuals with hearing impairments.

item.title: Plans for Direct Train Services from Rochdale to London Rejected by Rail Regulator
item.description: The Office of Rail and Road has rejected proposals for new direct train services between Rochdale and London Euston, citing capacity issues on the West Coast Main Line.
